verdict.rationale: All evidence describes Fern generating and hosting its own MCP server so external coding agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Windsurf) can query Fern's docs — this is Fern acting as an MCP server provider, not as a client that plugs in third-party MCP servers to gain their tools. Fern Agent (docs-8, docs-29) automates doc PRs but nothing shows it consuming external MCP servers' tools.
